definition: a pale hard wood with a fine grain
description: In a sunlit woodworking workshop, a young woman with long wavy hair, in a dark hoodie and leather apron, crouches on the sawdust-covered floor and smiles up as a blank skateboard deck of pale, smooth maple wood falls from the air. She catches it, holds it across her knee and runs her hand along its smooth surface. Stacks of thin light wooden sheets lean against the wall, blank decks hang on a wall rack and a press, a band saw and a workbench stand around her. A dog sleeps under the bench.

de.answer: Sie streicht über das Deck aus Ahorn.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está acariciando la tabla de arce.
